subject: modern-greek
summary: Modern Greek questions are short and clear, Greek letters and accents render correctly in both the serif question text and the scheme, and the attached article is the right one each time with no other questions visible on its first page. The weak point is the scheme for comprehension answers: the official sample answer is shown as one long paragraph with a single tick box, up to 20 lines on a phone, with leftover examiner marks such as 'κλπ......' and stray spaces before commas. The vocabulary card is the best example: the five phrases are listed on separate lines and the scheme gives five one-mark answers, though it does not say which answer goes with which phrase. The essay card shows a short sample thought rather than marking criteria.

issues.title: Comprehension scheme is one block paragraph with one tick
issues.detail: The scheme's sample answer is printed as a single paragraph with a single tick box: 16 lines on the phone for card 1 and 20 lines for card 3. There are no separate points to tick, so the student has to read a wall of small text and decide all-or-nothing against a 5-mark total.
issues.suggested_fix: Break the sample answer into its sentences or ideas, one per line, under a heading such as 'Sample answer - any equivalent ideas accepted'.

issues.title: Examiner leftovers and typing slips in scheme text
issues.detail: Sample answers end with a dot leader ('κλπ......', 'Κλπ.....'), have spaces before commas ('φόβος , η αγωνία', 'από εμάς , άλλες'), a split word ('ν α επιλέξει') and a dropped letter ('κα τη συσπείρωση'). These read as broken text to a student.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace 'κλπ......' with 'κλπ.'; normalise spacing around commas; fix the two split or truncated words if they are transcription slips rather than in the official scheme.

issues.title: Vocabulary answers not tied to their phrases
issues.detail: The question lists five phrases and the scheme gives five answers worth 1 mark each, but the answers carry no label, so the student has to assume the order matches (for example 'συνέπειες' is the answer for 'επιπτώσεις'). The first answer also has the grey language note stuck under it, which makes that box three times the height of the others.
issues.suggested_fix: Show each as 'εκτεταμένες - πολύ μεγάλες, διευρυμένες'. Move the language note out of the first tick box.

issues.title: Essay scheme is a sample sentence, not criteria
issues.detail: The 40-mark essay scheme is a five-line sample thought ending 'Κλπ.....' with one tick box. It does not tell the student how the 40 marks are earned. The question text runs the section instruction ('choose one of the two topics ... about 300 words') straight into the essay title.
issues.suggested_fix: Label it 'Example of a possible approach' and put the instruction on its own line above the title.

issues.title: Attachment title cut off and empty band on phone
issues.detail: On the phone the attachment button title is truncated to 'The article this question is about - ans...'. Below it there is a blank band of about 200 pixels before the answer box.
issues.suggested_fix: Shorten the title to 'Read the article' and collapse the gap.

good_examples.why: Five phrases listed on separate lines, five one-mark answers each with its own tick
Short question with a compact sample answer that plainly addresses it
